title: Mindtrek
wikitext:
A competition held in [[Finland]] in [[2003]]. [[Purity]] wrote a report about this in his [[Columns_Purity#Mindtrek|column]]. Some main points, [[Dare]] (from [[Clan MalFunction|cMF]]) left because the network lagged. [[Slackers]] didn't play in the [[4on4]] tournament because [[Slackers|SR]] [[Hib]] didn't bring a PC, [[Slackers|SR]] [[Slebe]] got drunk with mates that lived nearby and [[Xamp]] didn't enter the [[1on1]] tournament while just before this LAN he came in 2nd in [[Duelmania 3]], he lost the final to [[Milton]].
